systems.system: Sistema de Tramitação Electrónica de Processos Jurisdicionais (STEPJ)
systems.owner: Centro de Gestão de Tecnologias do Sector da Justiça (CGTSJ), under the Supreme Court
systems.tiers: all courts, Constitutional Council, Public Prosecution

note: Law 8/2024 creates the legal regime for the STEPJ and the CGTSJ and tasks the Government with creating the conditions for them to start operating (Art. 48); it states no system procured, piloted, built or in service.

facts.fact: The Mozambican Bar Association says the Supreme Court launched a Portal de Jurisprudencia that gives structured online access to decisions produced by the judicial courts.
